items.title: LEN Q3 Deep Dive: Interest Rates, Incentives, and Land Costs Weigh on Results
items.summary: Homebuilder Lennar (NYSE:LEN) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2026, with sales falling 8.7% year on year to $8.05 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.23 per share was 4.5% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
